cited.quote: Action will be taken to expedite the State Level Projects of Government of India
Constraints removed due to continuous action taken by the Government of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C2 (policy note) only states that action will be taken to expedite the project. C1 says work is in progress and constraints were removed, but names no dated GO, order or other official state step. No operationalising step is shown.

cited.quote: all the issues related to Parambikulam - Aliyar Project including Anamalayar Project and Nirar-Nallar Project were

rationale: C4 records an Inter-State meeting with Kerala on 17.09.2021 where issues of the Anamalayar Project were discussed, followed by a Technical Sub Committee on 01.10.2021. This is the start of negotiation talks on the project. Matching the promised dam to the Anamalayar Project is an inference.

No extract mentions the Dindigul-Cumbum-Koodalur broad gauge line or any request to the Union government for it. C2 and C3 cover land acquisition for other railway projects; C1, C4 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: Temple Ponds of HR and CE which serve recharge functionality may be taken up with NOC
Temple Ponds of Tourism, Culture and Religious Endowments Department which serve recharge functionality

rationale: C1 (GO of 2022-03-08) lets desilting under AGAMT-II be taken up in temple ponds, and C4 repeats this for 2024-25. Coverage is limited to temple ponds serving a recharge function, with a NOC, within a rural scheme. This is not a statewide periodic programme, so partial.

cited.quote: a Journalist Welfare Board has been constituted and the funds are determined to
guidelines for grant of welfare assistance in Journalist Welfare Board and applications have been published in October 2023

rationale: C1 shows a Journalist Welfare Board constituted after an Assembly announcement of 06.09.2021. C3 shows its committee and the October 2023 assistance guidelines. It is a board, not a commission, and nothing in these extracts links it to enforcing the Majithia recommendations. The date is the earliest operational step dated in the extracts.

No extract mentions HR and CE part-time or contract workers or their regularisation. C1 describes the general Act on permanent status for industrial workmen. C2 and C3 cover ESI benefits and C4 and C5 cover labour code rules. None concern this commitment.

No extract concerns a scheme letting households save up to Rs 6000 a year. The extracts cover panchayat finance grants, small savings interest rates and rural housing, none of which is this commitment.

cited.quote: A Journalist Welfare Board Committee has been constituted with the Minister for Information and Publicity as

rationale: The only related activity is the Journalist Welfare Board (C2, C3), a board for journalists, a different group from photographers or videographers. No extract shows a welfare board for new professions such as photographers. C1 concerns minority boards.

cited.quote: TAHDCO construction wing has taken up 502 works to a total value of Rs.380.64 crore under various schemes
The TAHDCO is undertaking construction of hostels for Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare department

rationale: C2 (2021-12-30) reports TAHDCO taking up works including new hostel buildings and repairs for Adi Dravidar and Tribal students. C1 and C4 report continued hostel construction and works worth hundreds of crores. The date is that of the earliest report in the extracts, not a GO, hence moderate confidence.

cited.quote: had not initiated any recruitment process for Physical Education Teachers

rationale: No extract shows any step to make part-time art, music or PE teachers permanent. C5 gives a quota for existing secondary-grade-pay teachers, including Art Masters and Music Teachers, in direct recruitment for another post. That is a different group and measure. C3 notes no PE recruitment was initiated.

cited.quote: detaching from the Public Works Department to study the cause and impact of recent natural calamities

rationale: C3 and C4 describe an independent Water Resources Department detached from the Public Works Department, with the same mandate on calamities and water augmentation. The exact creation date is not stated in the extracts, so the year of C4 is used. It is a department rather than a ministry, but it matches the substance.

cited.quote: Rs.37.00 lakh has been sanctioned to set up these centres
These Elders Resource Centre functions as Day Care centres unlike shelter homes

rationale: C3 (policy note of 2021-12-29) reports Rs 37 lakh sanctioned for Elders Resource Centres run through NGOs on a pilot basis in two blocks of each of 37 districts. This is a dedicated measure matching the directional promise. Its exact start date is not given, so the note date is used.

cited.quote: Skill training programmes across Government departments will be better integrated through the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation

rationale: No extract shows a new State Board of Skill Training and Employment Promotion (STEP). C3 and C5 show skill programmes being integrated through the existing Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation, a neighbouring step but a different institution.

No extract is about listing construction materials as essential items or supplying them at a fair price. C1 and C2 cover fair price shops for ration items, C3 covers material quality testing, C4 covers MGNREGS rates and C5 covers forest raw material prices.

cited.quote: this Government will continue to urge the Union Government to declare Tamil, as one of the official languages of India

rationale: C1 (Governor's Address, 2021-06-21) is only a statement of intent. C2 shows letters on Tamil as the High Court language, a different matter. No Assembly resolution, letter or GO urging that all state languages be made official languages of India is shown.

cited.quote: Guidelines for organising special camps in every villages to redress the issues related to Patta
Special camps are conducted for a group of villages in rural areas or designated areas

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2021-10-11 ordering special camps in every village on patta issues. C3 reports the Makkaludan Mudhalvar camps in rural areas from 2023-24. The promise does not say what 'these issues' are, so the match is uncertain. Special village-level public camps were held.

cited.quote: all State Public Sector Undertakings, Statutory Boards, Municipal Corporations and Apex Co-operatives will be mandated to join

rationale: C5 mandates PSUs to join the TReDS bill discounting platform. That concerns paying MSME bills, not a 15 percent purchase goal or a 10 percent discount. C4 gives procurement concessions to startups, a different group. No step on the promised purchase target is shown.

cited.quote: offering advanced sports training tailored to individual needs
G.O. (Ms) No.67, Youth Welfare and Sports Development (S1) Department, dated 24.08.2023

rationale: C3 reports Centres of Excellence and Sports Hostels of Excellence giving advanced training across many disciplines. C4 and C2 describe high cash incentives for medallists, with C4 citing a GO of 24.08.2023. The earliest dated GO in the extracts is used as the date, so the true first step may be earlier.

cited.quote: the Government is urging the Union Government to take all necessary steps to ensure that

rationale: C2 shows the state urging the Union to drop creamy layer exclusion and to implement the 27 percent OBC quota. That is a related but different advocacy subject, not the income ceiling of Rs 25 lakh. C4 and C5 are state creamy layer equivalence orders, not a request to the Union.

cited.quote: The final draft Bill was placed in the High Level Committee meeting under the chairmanship of Chief Secretary
The draft Act has been reviewed by High Level Committee headed by Chief Secretary to Government of Tamilnadu on 25.11.2021

rationale: C1 and C3 show committees formed, a draft Groundwater Act prepared, then a final draft Bill put before the High Level Committee on 15.03.2024, with suggestions still being incorporated. No bill introduced or Act enacted is shown, so preparatory official steps only.
